hooks.command:
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/VERSION" ]; then exit 0; fi
V=$(awk 'NF{print $NF; exit}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/VERSION" 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$V" ] || V=dev
if [ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ] && printf %s "${COLORTERM:-}" | grep -qiE 'truecolor|24bit'; then
  G1=$(printf '\033[38;2;153;69;255m'); G2=$(printf '\033[38;2;131;98;237m')
  G3=$(printf '\033[38;2;109;126;220m'); G4=$(printf '\033[38;2;86;155;202m')
  G5=$(printf '\033[38;2;64;184;184m'); G6=$(printf '\033[38;2;42;212;167m')
  G7=$(printf '\033[38;2;20;241;149m')
  DM=$(printf '\033[2;38;2;100;100;100m'); RS=$(printf '\033[0m')
else
  G1=; G2=; G3=; G4=; G5=; G6=; G7=; DM=; RS=
fi
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G1" '   _____ ____  __    ___    _   _____' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G2" '  / ___// __ \/ /   /   |  / | / /   |' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G3" '  \__ \/ / / / /   / /| | /  |/ / /| |' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G4" ' ___/ / /_/ / /___/ ___ |/ /|  / ___ |' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G5" '/____/\____/_____/_/  |_/_/ |_/_/  |_|' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G6" '           ▄▀█ █   █▄▀ █ ▀█▀' "$RS"
printf '%s%s%s\n' "$G7" '           █▀█ █   █ █ █  █' "$RS"
printf '%s\n\n' "${DM}     v$V — by @SuperteamBR 🇧🇷${RS}"
if command -v solana >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "🔗 $(solana config get | grep 'RPC URL' | awk '{print $3}')"
  echo "👛 $(solana address 2>/dev/null || echo 'No wallet configured')"
else
  echo '⚠️  Solana CLI not found'
fi

INPUT=$(cat)
NAME=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.agent_type // .agent_id // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null)
echo "🤖 Agent completed: ${NAME:-unknown}"

INPUT=$(cat)
FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0

case "$FILE" in
  *.rs)
    command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && rustfmt "$FILE" || true
    ;;
  *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md)
    command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$FILE" || true
    ;;
esac

INPUT=$(cat)
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT")
printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE 'cargo test|anchor test' || exit 0
OUT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_response | if type=="string" then . else (.stdout // "") + "\n" + (.stderr // "") end' 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$OUT" ] || OUT=$INPUT

echo ""
echo "📊 Test Summary:"
if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -qE 'test result: FAILED|error\[|panicked|failing'; then
  echo "❌ Some tests failed. Review output above."
else
  echo "✅ All tests passed!"
fi

INPUT=$(cat)
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT")
printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE 'dotnet test|unity-editor.*-runTests' || exit 0
OUT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_response | if type=="string" then . else (.stdout // "") + "\n" + (.stderr // "") end' 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$OUT" ] || OUT=$INPUT

echo ""
echo "📊 .NET Test Summary:"
if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -qE 'Failed!|Failed: *[1-9]|error'; then
  echo "❌ Some tests failed. Review output above."
else
  echo "✅ All tests passed!"
fi

INPUT=$(cat)
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT")
if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '\.ssh/|\.gnupg|\.aws/|\.config/solana/id\.json|\.npmrc|\.git-credentials|\.netrc|\.cargo/credentials|\.docker/config\.json|\.config/gh/hosts|\.kube/config|\.pypirc|\.gem/credentials|Application[\\ ]+Support/Google/Chrome|Application[\\ ]+Support/BraveSoftware|Application[\\ ]+Support/Microsoft[\\ ]+Edge|Application[\\ ]+Support/Firefox|Application[\\ ]+Support/Chromium|Application[\\ ]+Support/Vivaldi|Application[\\ ]+Support/Arc|Application[\\ ]+Support/com\.operasoftware|\.config/google-chrome|\.config/BraveSoftware|\.config/microsoft-edge|\.mozilla/firefox|\.config/chromium|\.config/vivaldi|\.config/opera|AppData/Local/Google/Chrome|AppData/Local/BraveSoftware|AppData/Local/Microsoft/Edge|AppData/Roaming/Mozilla/Firefox|AppData/Local/Chromium|AppData/Local/Vivaldi|AppData/Roaming/Opera[\\ ]+Software|Local[\\ ]+Extension[\\ ]+Settings|moz-extension'; then
  echo '🛑 Blocked: reading private keys, wallet vaults, or credentials is not allowed. Use `solana address` for your pubkey.' >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre-deploy.sh"; if [ ! -r "$S" ]; then echo "pre-deploy gate missing — refusing to run deploy commands" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$S"
